asset_set: Questionnaire Q4 option 1 — Repairing smartphone hardware

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under phone and wrists — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; subtle circuit-line suggestion on exposed board via 3 thin traces max
art_style.mood: precise hobbyist-repair energy — approachable bench tinkering, not an industrial teardown line
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame
readable text or brand logos on phone

accent.name: KursoKo teal
accent.use: battery insulation tape, precision screwdriver tip band, cuff pinstripe

secondary.name: lavender
secondary.use: small parts tray liner, secondary ribbon cable

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: teal appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlights on screwdriver shaft and tweezers tip
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under hands and phone body

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: steadies an open smartphone with its back panel removed
left_hand.grip: flat fingers cradling the phone edges, thumb resting on the frame
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: lifts a small battery pack free with fine-tip tweezers
right_hand.grip: precision pinch grip on the tweezers
right_hand.position: center-right, hovering over the open phone cavity

pose.gesture_summary: mid-repair freeze frame — battery lifted just clear of its slot
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

accessories.placement: left wrist, thin coiled band with small grounding clip

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands works on an open smartphone with its back panel removed, exposing a small circuit board and battery. Fine-tip tweezers lift the battery pack free while a precision screwdriver and a small parts tray of tiny screws sit ready nearby, capturing the careful precision of hands-on hardware repair rather than a factory teardown line.

primary_objects.name: open smartphone with exposed internals
primary_objects.detail: back panel removed, violet circuit board visible, sky-blue battery pack lifting free

primary_objects.name: battery pack
primary_objects.detail: teal insulation tape strip along one edge

primary_objects.name: precision screwdriver
primary_objects.detail: teal tip band, tiny Phillips head visible

primary_objects.name: small parts tray
primary_objects.detail: shallow compartments with five miniature screws

subject.environment: light birch workbench surface strip across bottom third — fades to transparent at edges, no factory backdrop

composition.layout: diagonal workflow line from parts tray → open phone → tweezers lifting battery
focal_hierarchy: right hand lifting battery with tweezers
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 48px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: bench edge only — no wall
composition.thumbnail_readability: phone silhouette + two hand shapes readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, letter R, brand name on phone, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, factory line, guns, blood
